title: How to work out GST on a bill
summary: Add GST to a price, or take it out of a price, step by step.

sections.heading: Add GST to a price
paragraphs: Find the GST amount from the rate. Add it to the price before tax.

sections.heading: Take GST out of a price
paragraphs: If a price already includes GST, you can work out the price before tax from the rate.

sections.heading: Use the calculator
paragraphs: The free GST calculator does both. Tap a rate and type the amount.

sections.heading: Keep your bills clear
paragraphs: Show the price before GST, the GST and the total on the bill. It helps your customers and your CA.
